src_text_full: They were so huge that the spoons they used were as large as spades,
And their forks as big as hay-forks with these they lifted whole bucketfuls of broth and great joints of meat out of an enormous pot which was set on the ground between them.
Niels was startled and rather scared at first,
but he comforted himself with the thought that the giants were a good way off,

reference_text: 他们个子大得惊人，用的勺子像铁锹一样大，叉子也和草叉一样大。他们用这些餐具从两人中间放在地上的一个巨大锅里，把一桶桶肉汤和大块大块的肉直接舀出来。尼尔斯起初大吃一惊，有点害怕，但他安慰自己说，巨人离他们还远着呢。
